summary: Elevate your leadership skills with our comprehensive training course. Gain insights, strategies, and tools to become an effective leader in any environment.
lede: Leadership training covers practical ways to guide teams, coach performance, and address workplace conflict. It is designed for professionals taking on responsibility for people, processes, and strategic outcomes, and develops skills in adapting leadership styles, coaching, stakeholder engagement, and change communication. Exercises include creating a situational leadership matrix, coaching colleagues, and planning stakeholder engagement.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who have transitioned into roles requiring the management of people, processes, and strategic outcomes.
audience: High-potential Individual Contributors identified for future leadership
modules: The GROW® Coaching and Performance Framework
prerequisites: Participants should currently hold a supervisory or management role, or have been identified for a leadership transition within the next six months. A basic understanding of organizational structures and performance management processes is recommended. No specific technical prerequisites are required, though familiarity with standard project management tools is beneficial.
